mentions.name: Circadian Mode for Philips Hue
mentions.description: An app for Philips Hue lighting, currently in public beta, that makes very minor, imperceptible changes every few seconds so lights gradually dim as the night goes on.

mentions.name: Circadian Mode for Philips Hue
mentions.description: A web app that gives Philips Hue lights circadian behavior, gradually shifting from bright light during the day to dim, low-blue light at night; positioned as more powerful and easier to use than first- and third-party options from Hue, Apple, and Home Assistant.
mentions.problem: Existing circadian lighting options from Hue, Apple, and Home Assistant are less powerful and harder to use.
mentions.source_excerpt: Circadian Mode for Philips Hue[2]: A web app that gives your Philips Hue lights circadian powers, so that they gradually shift from bright light during the day to dim, low-blue light at night. It's way more powerful and easier to use than first- and third-party options from Hue, Apple, and Home Assistant. Just launched this week; looking for beta testers to give feedback!
